title: Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee - September 17, 2024
meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom webinar ID: 811 3243 2022
Those who require a telephone number to call into the Zoom meeting may contact the committee coordinator.
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak by phone or email, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 2 pm on the day of the meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: Update on the Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee’s Terms of Reference
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Sarah Taylor, Director, Community Safety, Well-Being, Policy and Analytics, provided a presentation and answered questions from the Committee.  A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
At the conclusion of the discussions, the Committee received the update:

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee receive the update for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Update on Priorities for the Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee – Integrated and Simpler Systems, and Housing
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Sarah Taylor, Director, Community Safety, Well-Being, Policy and Analytics, Sarah Mullen, Program Manager, Social Development, Sonia Luberti, Manager, Strategic Projects, and Derek McMaster, Manager, Collaborative Planning and Projects, provided a presentation and answered questions from the Committee.  A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
Robin Browne (613/819 Black Hub) spoke before the Committee and provided comments on the item.
At the conclusion of discussions, the Committee received the update:

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee receive the update for information.

agenda_items.title: Notices of Motions (For Consideration at Subsequent Meeting)
agenda_items.minutes: There were no Notices of Motion.
